requirements.title: NZ Health Certificate A (home-country attestations, APHIS-endorsed)
NZ Health Certificate B (pre-export inspection / seal, APHIS-endorsed)

manual_checklist.title: Read MPI's CATDOG.GEN import health standard
manual_checklist.detail: The governing standard (full PDF on MPI's website) walks the timeline. Reading it before booking saves expensive re-bookings later.

manual_checklist.title: Apply for the MPI Permit to Import
manual_checklist.detail: Apply online well ahead (allow ~20 business days / ~30 working days). Without the permit the pet is refused entry.

manual_checklist.title: RNATT sample 3–24 months before shipment
manual_checklist.detail: MPI requires a rabies neutralising antibody titre (FAVN/RFFIT) ≥0.5 IU/mL with the sample collected between 3 and 24 months before shipment — a 3-month minimum wait, NOT Australia's 180 days.

manual_checklist.title: Dog-only tests + double parasite treatments
manual_checklist.detail: Dogs additionally need heartworm (treat + negative ELISA), Babesia gibsoni, Brucella canis, and leptospirosis testing/treatment per CATDOG.GEN, plus two internal and two external parasite treatments and a pre-export exam. Confirm the schedule with your vet.

manual_checklist.title: Reserve an MPI-facility quarantine slot (min 10 days)
manual_checklist.detail: Auckland or Christchurch transitional facility, minimum 10 days. A confirmed booking is mandatory before travel. Book early.
